Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: add complete auth system with 2FA, HttpOnly cookies, and rate limiting

Adapted from Colonos project auth implementation:
- Login with SignInService, 2FA detection, and HttpOnly cookie refresh tokens
- Refresh token rotation via cookie \(not request body\)
- Logout with token revocation
- Email confirmation and resend confirmation flows
- Forgot password and reset password with token revocation
- Two-factor authentication \(enable, verify, disable, login with 2FA\)
- Google Authenticator QR code generation
- Rate limiting \(10 req/min for auth, 200 req/min for API\)
- Enhanced JwtTokenService with revoke, validate, and GetPrincipalFromExpiredToken
- SignInService, EmailService \(simulated\), TwoFactorService
- TwoFactorController for 2FA management endpoints

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
